description: The wind energy facility will have a capacity of up to 800 MW.
context_quote: Under Alternative A, the Proposed Action, the construction, operation, maintenance, and eventual decommissioning of an up to 800 MW wind energy facility on the OCS offshore Massachusetts within the proposed Project area and associated export cables would occur within the range of design parameters outlined in the Vineyard Wind COP (Epsilon 2018, 2019, 2020), subject to applicable mitigation measures.

description: No surface occupancy will occur in the northernmost portion of the project area to potentially reduce visual impacts and conflicts with existing ocean uses.
geographic_scope: Northernmost portion of the project area
context_quote: Under Alternative C, the No Surface Occupancy in the Northernmost Portion of the Project Area Alternative, the construction, operation, maintenance, and eventual decommissioning of an up to 800 MW wind energy facility on the OCS offshore Massachusetts within the proposed Project area and associated export cables would occur within the range of the design parameters outlined in the Vineyard Wind COP, subject to applicable mitigation measures. However, no surface occupancy would occur in the northernmost portion of the proposed Project area to potentially reduce the visual impacts of the proposed Project and potential conflicts with existing ocean uses, such as, marine navigation and commercial fishing. This alternative would result in the exclusion of approximately six of the northernmost WTG locations.

description: The wind turbine layout will have a minimum spacing of 1 nautical mile between turbines and the lanes between turbines will also be a minimum of 1 nautical mile.
context_quote: Under Alternative D1, WTGs would have a minimum spacing of 1 nmi between them, and the lanes between turbines would also be a minimum of 1 nmi to potentially reduce conflicts with existing ocean uses, such as commercial fishing and marine navigation.

description: The wind turbine layout will be arranged in an east-west orientation with a minimum spacing of 1 nautical mile between turbines in the east-west direction.
context_quote: Under Alternative D2, the wind turbine layout would be arranged in an east-west orientation and all WTGs in the east-west direction would have a minimum spacing of 1 nmi between them to allow for vessels to travel in an unobstructed path between rows of turbines in an east- west direction.

description: The proposed project will consist of no more than 84 wind turbine generators.
context_quote: Under Alternative E, the Reduced Project Size Alternative, the construction, operation, maintenance, and eventual decommissioning of a large-scale commercial wind energy facility on the OCS offshore Massachusetts within the proposed Project area and associated export cables would occur within the range of the design parameters outlined in the Vineyard Wind COP, subject to applicable mitigation measures, with the following exception: the proposed Project would consist of no more than 84 WTGs in order to potentially reduce impacts on existing ocean uses and environmental resources.

description: A vessel transit lane through the wind development area will be established in which no surface occupancy will occur.
context_quote: Under Alternative F, a vessel transit lane through the WDA would be established in which no surface occupancy would occur. The lane included in this alternative, and not included in other alternatives, could potentially facilitate transit of vessels through the project area from southern New England ports—primarily New Bedford—to fishing areas on Georges Bank.

description: Bird deterrent devices will be installed on the wind turbine generators and electrical service platform to minimize bird attraction.
geographic_scope: Wind turbine generators and electrical service platform
context_quote: Install bird deterrent devices to minimize bird attraction to operating turbines and on the ESP(s), where appropriate and where Vineyard Wind determines such devices can be employed safely.

description: Export cable installation activities will not be initiated between April 1 and August 31 to avoid impacts on nesting Piping Plovers.
context_quote: Installation of export cable conduits is not expected to be initiated between April 1 and August 31. If horizontal directional drilling (HDD) activities are initiated between April 1 and August 31, or if work is re-initiated after a 48- hour work stoppage during the Piping Plover nesting season (the aforementioned time period), the Massachusetts Natural Heritage and Endangered Species Program (NHESP), USFWS, and BOEM must be notified with the reason, anticipated duration of the work, and any additional information requested by NHESP, USFWS, and BOEM.

description: If export cable installation activities must occur between April 1 and August 31, a qualified biologist will survey the area within 200 yards of the work zone to determine the presence/absence of nesting Piping Plovers.
geographic_scope: Area within 200 yards of export cable installation work zone
context_quote: If HDD activities are initiated between April 1 and August 31, or if work is re-initiated after a 48-hour work stoppage during the Piping Plover nesting season (the aforementioned time period), a qualified biologist will perform surveys to determine the presence/absence of any nesting Piping Plovers within 200 yards (182.9 meters) of the work zone.

description: An Aircraft Detection Lighting System (ADLS) will be used to activate the FAA hazard lighting only when an aircraft is in the vicinity of the wind facility.
context_quote: Require use of FAA-approved-ADLS, which will only activate the FAA hazard lighting when an aircraft is in the vicinity of the wind facility, to reduce the visibility of nighttime lighting and thus reduce nighttime visual impacts.

description: Trees greater than 3 inches in diameter at breast height shall not be cleared from June 1 to July 31 to avoid impacts on northern long-eared bats.
context_quote: Require that trees greater than 3 inches (7.6 centimeters) diameter at breast height not be cleared from June 1 to July 31.

description: Dredging and cable installation activities must use the least environmentally harmful method and avoid high concentrations of fishing activities and natural resource events.
context_quote: Require dredging and cable installation activities to use the least environmentally harmful method that will be effective in each area and to use updated habitat information (Measure #15) to avoid/minimize impacts on benthic habitat to the maximum extent practicable. Require all vessels deploying anchors to use, whenever feasible and safe, mid-line anchor buoys to reduce the amount of anchor chain or line that touches the seafloor. Require nearshore cable-laying activities to avoid high concentrations of fishing activities and natural resource events (spawning and egg laying).

description: Cable laying operations in the northern part of the offshore export cable area within Nantucket Sound waters will occur outside of April to June.
geographic_scope: Northern part of offshore export cable area within Nantucket Sound
context_quote: The non-HDD cable laying operations in the northern part of the offshore export cable area within Nantucket Sound waters will occur outside of April to June.

description: Cable protection measures within complex hard-bottom habitat will consist of natural or engineered stone that does not inhibit epibenthic growth and provides three-dimensional complexity.
geographic_scope: Areas with complex hard-bottom habitat along the cable route
context_quote: Cable protection measures within complex hard-bottom habitat as defined in the COP, EFH Assessment (BOEM 2019, 2020), and additional data from Measure #15 will consist of natural or engineered stone that does not inhibit epibenthic growth and provides three-dimensional complexity, both in height and in interstitial spaces.

description: Vineyard Wind will process at least 75 benthic grabs and 60 underwater video transects along the entire offshore export cable corridor to map seafloor habitats prior to cable installation.
context_quote: At a minimum, Vineyard Wind will process 75 benthic grabs over the entire length of the OECC (with approximately 42 in the eastern Muskeget section) and 60 underwater video transects over the entire length of the OECC (with 28 transects in the eastern Muskeget section).

description: Dredge disposal sites will be limited in number and located in areas that do not contain sensitive resources.
context_quote: Where dredging is necessary, Vineyard Wind will clearly identify a limited number of dredge disposal sites within known sand wave areas, and to the maximum extent practicable, ensure that these sites do not contain resources that will be damaged by sediment deposition.

description: The locations of dredge disposal sites will be reported to regulatory agencies within 30 days of disposal.
context_quote: The locations of dredge disposal sites must be reported to BOEM, NOAA, MassDEP, and Massachusetts CZM within 30 days of disposal of materials.

description: The export cable will be continuously monitored using a Distributed Temperature Sensing System, and any significant changes in burial conditions will be reported to BOEM.
context_quote: In addition to inspection, the export cable will be monitored continuously with the as-built DTS System. If DTS data indicate that burial conditions have deteriorated or changed significantly and remedial actions are warranted, the DTS data, a seabed stability analysis, and report of remedial actions taken or scheduled must be provided to BOEM within 45 calendar days of the observations.
